pairs.subject: design-doc-compliance-scoring
pairs.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/SuggestionsPanel.tsx:45 The view shows reconciliation suggestions as one ranked column (#1, #2, …) in the engine's order, so each module's trivial 'Update GDD' bookkeeping item is ranked above its 'Fix critical gaps' item: the tick-the-box-first triage the standard warns against.

techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/SuggestionsPanel.tsx:45 Each gap row carries a direction indicator, and unmeasured gaps get no lean (GapIndicators.tsx:22). But the suggestions panel ranks code-ahead doc edits and design-ahead build work in one priority column, with the doc edits first in each module.
src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/EvidenceStrip.tsx:10 Coverage is shown next to the score with its basis ('X of Y'), plus a named confidence band label rather than a tint.

src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/MappingStrip.tsx:60 Items related only by a guess are listed as unmapped and labelled as guesses. The strip reports mapped, un-evidenceable, heuristic, unmapped and dangling counts separately.

src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/EvidenceStrip.tsx:25 Shows the newest and oldest review ages, the undated count, and the stale threshold. Age is measured against the report's own generatedAt. 'Audit ran' is printed as a separate fact (index.tsx:202).

src/components/modules/evaluator/GDDComplianceView/ModuleCard.tsx:35 An unmeasured module shows the word UNMEASURED and a dashed empty bar, never a number. The header ScoreRing receives measured={report.evidence.measured} and shows '—' when it is false.
